local.command:
# Auto-detect the RoCE-v2 IPv4 GID index (per node, re-numbers across reboots).
for HCA in $(echo "${NCCL_IB_HCA}" | tr ',' ' '); do
  for i in $(seq 0 15); do
    t=$(cat /sys/class/infiniband/$HCA/ports/1/gid_attrs/types/$i 2>/dev/null || true)
    g=$(cat /sys/class/infiniband/$HCA/ports/1/gids/$i 2>/dev/null || true)
    case "$t" in *"RoCE v2"*) case "$g" in *0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:ffff:*) export NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=$i; break 2;; esac;; esac
  done
done
vllm serve /models/glm-5.3-flash-nvfp4 --served-model-name glm-5.3-flash --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --trust-remote-code --tensor-parallel-size 4 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.6158 --profiler-config '{"profiler":"torch","torch_profiler_dir":"/prof","torch_profiler_with_stack":false}' --max-model-len 1048576 --max-num-seqs 4 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --block-size 2304 --moe-backend flashinfer_b12x --enable-prefix-caching --load-format instanttensor --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model":"/models/dflash2-draft","num_speculative_tokens":5,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","draft_tensor_parallel_size":1}' --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --num-gpu-blocks-override 1056 --mamba-cache-dtype auto  --scheduler-cls vllm.v1.core.sched.glm53_decode_first.Glm53DecodeFirstScheduler --max-cudagraph-capture-size 32 --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY","custom_ops":["all"],"pass_config":{"fuse_gemm_comms":true,"fuse_allreduce_rms":true,"fuse_attn_quant":true}}' --enable-flashinfer-autotune --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image":4,"video":1}' --tool-call-parser glm47 --enable-auto-tool-choice --reasoning-parser glm45 --chat-template /models/glm-5.3-flash-nvfp4/chat_template.0b76cfb35dfd15db1109043c77e99b807bf95024b5b71ca8b435e1c3a844fb42.jinja --middleware vllm.glm53_chat.ChatContractMiddleware --distributed-executor-backend mp --disable-custom-all-reduce --nnodes 4 --master-addr 10.10.10.2 --master-port 29521 --node-rank 0 > /glmlogs/glm53.log 2>&1
